summary: The width-ratio predecessor applies exactly. The triangle lemma is valid, including support-value ties: its barycentric identity yields one of the two incident edge determinants at least 2BR, and averaging that edge with the extremal segment of P0 gives a nondegenerate parallelogram in K of area at least BR/2. The strict area inequalities then give the full claimed chain, and the factor-one-half parallelogram bound excludes an area-one containing triangle.
